gatewayRequired: The OpenClaw Gateway needs to be running to use chat. It will start automatically, or you can start it from Settings.

welcome.title: WorkMate Agent Platform
welcome.subtitle: Connect park operations, leasing, enterprise services, knowledge, and internal system data so employees can use natural language to run governed business Skills.

workOrder.title: Park Tickets
workOrder.description: Repairs, complaints, inspections, dispatch, reminders, and SLA tracking.
workOrder.prompt: Create a park ticket: Building A3, floor 2, Beijing WorkMate U Valley has an air conditioner cooling issue that affects tenant operations. Classify it, assign priority, suggest the responsible team, and draft the dispatch note.

investment.title: Leasing Match
investment.description: Extract customer needs and match parks, space, policies, and next actions.
investment.prompt: Analyze an investment leasing lead: a new energy parts company needs a 3,000 sqm factory in North China and wants to move in within three months. Generate the company profile, matching criteria, and follow-up plan.

enterpriseService.title: Enterprise Services
enterpriseService.description: Orchestrate policy, financing, HR, legal, and overseas services.
enterpriseService.prompt: A tenant wants to apply for a specialized and innovative SME policy. List the information to collect, materials needed, service workflow, and risk points requiring human confirmation.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Q&A
knowledge.description: Query policies, contract rules, SOPs, park materials, and cases.
knowledge.prompt: Find and summarize the park repair SOP as step-by-step guidance, and mark which steps require operations staff confirmation.

operationInsight.title: Operations Insight
operationInsight.description: Summarize ticket trends, SLA risk, frequent issues, and satisfaction.
operationInsight.prompt: Generate this week's park operations dashboard: focus on ticket trends, SLA overdue risk, frequent issues, responsible team distribution, and management suggestions.

identity.title: Org Permissions
identity.body: Load visible data and executable actions by HQ, city company, park, and tenant roles.

skills.title: Business Skills
skills.body: Package tickets, leasing, policies, notifications, and BI as governed digital assets.

audit.title: Security Audit
audit.body: Require confirmation for high-risk actions and retain user, object, result, and timestamp records.

skillFactory.title: Employee Skill Factory
skillFactory.body: Business teams can submit Skills that are validated, reviewed, installed, and governed as enterprise assets.

dataConnectors.title: Internal Data Connectors
dataConnectors.body: Use MCP/API proxies for OA, ERP, CRM, ticketing, contracts, BI, and park operations systems.

knowledgeHub.title: Enterprise Knowledge Hub
knowledgeHub.body: Manage policies, SOPs, templates, and cases with source-backed answers.

workflowGate.title: Workflow Gates
workflowGate.body: Separate read-only queries, low-risk writes, and high-risk approvals with human confirmation.

permissionAudit.title: Permission and Audit
permissionAudit.body: Control visibility by org, role, park, and data domain while logging each AI action and result.

agentOps.title: Agent Operations
agentOps.body: Track Skill quality, hit rate, failure rate, cost, and satisfaction with staged rollout and takedown.

taskPanel.title: Task Outline
taskPanel.emptyBody: Once a run starts, ClawX will surface thinking, tool calls, and handoff states here.

composer.agentPickerTitle: Route the next message to another agent
